claims.statement: Neptune is the Roman sea god and counterpart of Greek Poseidon.
claims.statement_id: Neptune adalah dewa laut Romawi yang berpadanan dengan Poseidon Yunani.
claims.quote: Neptune is the Roman god of the sea and the Roman equivalent of the Greek god Poseidon.

claims.statement: Neptune was originally a freshwater god before his early association with Poseidon.
claims.statement_id: Neptune semula dewa air tawar sebelum dikaitkan dengan Poseidon.
claims.quote: He was originally a god of fresh water and became associated with Poseidon early on in Roman history.

claims.statement: Neptune is the son of Saturn and Ops.
claims.statement_id: Neptune adalah putra Saturnus dan Ops.
claims.quote: He is the son of Saturn (the Roman counterpart of Cronus) and Ops (the Roman counterpart of Rhea).

claims.statement: Neptune was married to Salacia.
claims.statement_id: Neptune menikah dengan Salacia.
claims.quote: Neptune was married to Salacia (the Roman equivalent of the water goddess Amphitrite).

claims.statement: Neptune's trident was said to smash rocks, raise waves, create waters, and summon storms.
claims.statement_id: Trisula Neptune dikisahkan dapat memecah batu, mengangkat gelombang, membentuk perairan, dan memanggil badai.
claims.quote: He held a three-pronged trident which possessed extraordinary powers. Neptune used this trident to smash rocks, make waves, create new bodies of water, and call forth fierce storms.

claims.statement: A Roman bronze statue at The Met originally showed Neptune leaning on a trident.
claims.statement_id: Arca perunggu Romawi di The Met menampilkan Neptune bersandar pada trisula.
claims.quote: The god originally leaned on a trident, held in his left hand; his eyes and nipples were probably inlaid with silver and copper.

claims.statement: The Neptunalia was held annually on 23 July.
claims.statement_id: Perayaan Neptunalia diadakan setiap 23 Juli.
claims.quote: The Neptunalia was held on the 23rd of July every year, during the height of summer.

claims.statement: Romans sacrificed to Neptune seeking relief from summer water shortages.
claims.statement_id: Orang Romawi mempersembahkan kurban kepada Neptune agar kekurangan air pada musim panas mereda.
claims.quote: The Romans made sacrifices to Neptune so he would ease their water shortages during the heat, and they held chariot races.

claims.statement: In the Aeneid, Neptune calms the sea to aid Aeneas and his men.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Aeneid, Neptune menenangkan laut untuk membantu Aeneas dan pengikutnya.
claims.quote: Neptune in the Aeneid ... Neptune is angered by the storm, which he knows has been sent by his cunning sister Juno, and calms the waters to help Aeneas and his men.

claims.statement: Neptune lives in a golden palace at the bottom of the sea, where he holds court over sea gods and goddesses, sea nymphs, and sea creatures.
claims.statement_id: Neptune tinggal di istana emas di dasar laut dan memimpin dewa dan dewi laut, nimfa laut, serta makhluk laut.
claims.quote: He lives in a golden palace at the bottom of the sea, where he holds court over sea gods and goddesses, sea nymphs and sea creatures.

claims.statement: Neptune, Pluto and Jupiter drew lots for their realms: Neptune received the sea, Pluto the underworld, and Jupiter the sky and heavens.
claims.statement_id: Neptune, Pluto, dan Jupiter mengundi wilayah kekuasaan; Neptune mendapat laut, Pluto dunia bawah, dan Jupiter langit.
claims.quote: Neptune drew lots for the sea, Pluto for the underworld, and Jupiter for the sky and heavens.

claims.statement: On one occasion Neptune conspired with Juno and Minerva to overthrow Jupiter and put him in chains; Jupiter punished him and banished him to the sea.
claims.statement_id: Neptune pernah bersekongkol dengan Juno dan Minerva untuk menggulingkan Jupiter dan merantainya; Jupiter menghukumnya dan mengasingkannya ke laut.
claims.quote: on one occasion, he conspired with Juno (the Roman equivalent of Hera) and Minerva (the Roman counterpart of Athena) to overthrow him and put him in chains. For this disobedience, Jupiter punished him and banished him to the sea.

claims.statement: Neptune is described as riding a dolphin or giant sea shell beside his wife, pulled by whales and seahorses and always accompanied by sea gods and goddesses, many sea nymphs and their son Triton.
claims.statement_id: Neptune dikisahkan menunggang lumba-lumba atau kerang raksasa bersama istrinya, ditarik paus dan kuda laut, dan selalu dikawal dewa-dewi laut, banyak nimfa laut, serta putra mereka Triton.
claims.quote: He rode on a dolphin or a giant sea shell alongside his wife. They were pulled by whales and seahorses and were always accompanied by sea gods, goddesses, a large crowd of sea nymphs and Triton, their son.

claims.statement: According to Ovid, Neptune always had a sullen expression, while Virgil wrote that he had a mild demeanour.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Ovidius, Neptune selalu berwajah muram, sedangkan Virgil menulis bahwa ia berperangai lembut.
claims.quote: According to Ovid (43 BCE to 17 CE), Neptune always had a sullen expression, while Virgil (70-19 BCE) wrote that he had a mild demeanour

claims.statement: In his contest with Minerva, Neptune struck his trident on the ground and created the first horse, while Minerva made an olive tree rise from the earth.
claims.statement_id: Dalam perlombaan dengan Minerva, Neptune menghantamkan trisulanya ke tanah dan menciptakan kuda pertama, sedangkan Minerva menumbuhkan pohon zaitun.
claims.quote: Neptune struck his trident upon the ground and created a splendid horse to spring into existence, the first of its kind, while Minerva commanded a beautiful olive tree to rise from the earth.

claims.statement: After King Laomedon refused to pay, Neptune sent a flood to overwhelm Troy while Phoebus sent a plague.
claims.statement_id: Setelah Raja Laomedon menolak membayar upah, Neptune mengirim banjir untuk menenggelamkan Troya, sementara Phoebus mengirim wabah.
claims.quote: King Laomedon refused to give them anything, which shocked and angered the gods. So they left Troy, swearing to bring ruin upon the city, and so they did; Phoebus sent a deadly plague, and Neptune sent a flood to overwhelm the city.

claims.statement: Neptune sent Minos a magnificent bull and then punished him by making the bull too hard to handle.
claims.statement_id: Neptune mengirim banteng yang sangat indah kepada Minos, lalu menghukumnya dengan membuat banteng itu sulit dikendalikan.
claims.quote: Neptune answered his prayer by sending him the most magnificent bull ever seen. ... Neptune punished Minos by making the bull too hard to handle.

claims.statement: In the Greek-inspired tradition, Neptune is a brother of Jupiter and Pluto, who together preside over heaven, the earthly world (including the underworld) and the seas.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi yang dipengaruhi Yunani, Neptune bersaudara dengan Jupiter dan Pluto, yang bersama-sama memimpin langit, dunia bumi (termasuk dunia bawah), dan laut.
claims.quote: In the Greek-inspired tradition, he is a brother of Jupiter and Pluto, with whom he presides over the realms of heaven, the earthly world (including the underworld), and the seas.

claims.statement: Like Poseidon, Neptune was also worshipped by the Romans as a god of horses, Neptunus equestris, and a patron of horse-racing.
claims.statement_id: Seperti Poseidon, Neptune juga disembah orang Romawi sebagai dewa kuda, Neptunus equestris, sekaligus pelindung balap kuda.
claims.quote: Like Poseidon, he was also worshipped by the Romans as a god of horses, Neptunus equestris, who was also a patron of horse-racing.

claims.statement: Neptune had only one temple in Rome, the Temple of Neptune, near the Circus Flaminius in the southern Campus Martius, dating back to at least 206 BC.
claims.statement_id: Neptune hanya memiliki satu kuil di Roma, Temple of Neptune, dekat Circus Flaminius di bagian selatan Campus Martius, yang berasal dari sedikitnya 206 SM.
claims.quote: Neptune had only one temple in Rome, the Temple of Neptune. It stood near the Circus Flaminius, the Roman racetrack in the southern part of the Campus Martius, and dates back to at least 206 BC.

claims.statement: Neptune is one of only four Roman gods considered appropriate recipients of a bull sacrifice; the other three were Apollo, Mars and Jupiter.
claims.statement_id: Neptune adalah satu dari hanya empat dewa Romawi yang pantas diberi kurban banteng; tiga lainnya adalah Apollo, Mars, dan Jupiter.
claims.quote: Neptune is one of only four Roman gods to whom it was considered appropriate to sacrifice a bull. The other three were Apollo, Mars, and Jupiter

claims.statement: The lectisternium of 399 BC indicated that Poseidon, Artemis and Heracles had been introduced and worshipped in Rome as Neptune, Diana and Hercules.
claims.statement_id: Lectisternium tahun 399 SM menunjukkan bahwa Poseidon, Artemis, dan Herakles telah diperkenalkan dan disembah di Roma sebagai Neptune, Diana, dan Hercules.
claims.quote: The lectisternium of 399 BC indicated that the Greek figures of Poseidon, Artemis, and Heracles had been introduced and worshipped in Rome as Neptune, Diana, and Hercules.

claims.statement: Neptune was likely associated with freshwater springs before the sea; his festival Neptunalia fell on 23 July, at the height of summer when water was scarcest.
claims.statement_id: Neptune kemungkinan dikaitkan dengan mata air tawar sebelum dikaitkan dengan laut; Neptunalia jatuh pada 23 Juli, saat puncak musim panas ketika air paling langka.
claims.quote: He was likely associated with freshwater springs before the sea; his festival, Neptunalia, took place on July 23, during the peak of summer when water was scarcest.

claims.statement: The etymology of the Latin name Neptunus is unclear and disputed.
claims.statement_id: Asal-usul nama Latin Neptunus tidak jelas dan diperdebatkan.
claims.quote: The etymology of the Latin Neptunus is unclear and disputed.

claims.statement: The ancient grammarian Varro derived the name from nuptus ("covering"), alluding to nuptiae ("the marriage of Heaven and Earth").
claims.statement_id: Tata bahasa kuno Varro menurunkan nama itu dari nuptus ("penutup"), dengan merujuk pada nuptiae ("pernikahan Langit dan Bumi").
claims.quote: The ancient grammarian Varro derived the name from nuptus ("covering", opertio), alluding to nuptiae ("the marriage of Heaven and Earth").

claims.statement: The Etruscan name of Neptune is Nethuns.
claims.statement_id: Nama Neptune dalam bahasa Etruria adalah Nethuns.
claims.quote: The Etruscan name of Neptune is Nethuns.

claims.statement: In this epic passage, Neptune knows of the tempest that has disturbed his ocean and raises his sovereign brow above the sea in indignation.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bagian epik ini, Neptune mengetahui badai yang mengganggu samudranya dan mengangkat "dahi berdaulatnya" di atas laut dengan raut murka.
claims.quote: Meanwhile how all his smitten ocean moaned, and how the tempest's turbulent assault had vexed the stillness of his deepest cave, great Neptune knew; and with indignant mien uplifted o'er the sea his sovereign brow.

claims.statement: In this passage, the great god helps free the ships from the reef with his trident and then calms the whole sea, with Cymothoe and Triton also at work.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bagian ini, dewa agung itu membantu membebaskan kapal dari karang dengan trisulanya, lalu menenangkan seluruh laut; Cymothoe dan Triton juga bekerja.
claims.quote: Cymothoe then and Triton, with huge toil, thrust down the vessels from the sharp-edged reef; while, with the trident, the great god's own hand assists the task; then, from the sand-strewn shore out-ebbing far, he calms the whole wide sea

claims.statement: The phoenix is a legendary red-and-gold bird that radiates sunlight.
claims.statement_id: Phoenix adalah burung legendaris berbulu merah keemasan dan bercahaya.
claims.quote: THE PHOINIX (Phoenix) was a fabulous, red-gold feathered bird whose body emitted rays of pure sunlight.

claims.statement: One account gives the phoenix a five-hundred-year life and a diet of Arabian balsam and frankincense.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu uraian phoenix hidup lima ratus tahun dan memakan balsam serta kemenyan Arab.
claims.quote: The creature lived for five hundred years and feasted upon Arabian balsalm and frankinsense.

claims.statement: When a phoenix dies, a new one emerges from its body.
claims.statement_id: Saat phoenix mati, phoenix baru muncul dari tubuhnya.
claims.quote: When it died a new Phoinix emerged fully-grown from its body.

claims.statement: Herodotus said he had never seen a phoenix, only pictures of it.
claims.statement_id: Herodotus menulis bahwa ia tidak pernah melihat phoenix dan hanya mengenalnya dari gambar.
claims.quote: Herodotus, Histories 2. 73 (trans. Godley) ... I myself have never seen it, only pictures of it; for the bird seldom comes into Aigyptos (Egypt) : once in five hundred years, as the people of Heliopolis say.

claims.statement: In Herodotus's account, the phoenix carries its parent's body from Arabia to a sun temple wrapped in myrrh.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Herodotus, phoenix membawa jasad induknya dari Arabia ke kuil matahari dalam balutan mur.
claims.quote: Herodotus, Histories 2. 73 (trans. Godley) ... Flying from Arabia to the temple of the Helios (the Sun), they say, he conveys his father encased in myrrh and buries him at the temple of Helios [i.e. in the temple of the Egyptian god Ra].

claims.statement: Ovid says a young phoenix is reborn from its parent's body.
claims.statement_id: Ovid mengisahkan phoenix kecil lahir kembali dari jasad induknya.
claims.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... Then from his father's body is reborn a little Phoenix, so they say, to live the same long years.

claims.statement: According to a story that has gained more currency in modern times, the phoenix, on reaching a very old age (some say 500 and others 1461 years), committed itself to the flames.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kisah yang lebih populer di zaman modern, phoenix yang mencapai usia sangat tua (ada yang menyebut 500 tahun, ada yang 1461 tahun) menyerahkan dirinya ke api.
claims.quote: According to a story which has gained more currency in modern times, Phoenix, when he arrived at a very old age (some say 500 and others 1461 years), committed himself to the flames.

claims.statement: Chinese fenghuang is often translated 'phoenix' but is a distinct mythical bird.
claims.statement_id: Fenghuang Tiongkok sering diterjemahkan 'phoenix', tetapi menurut The Met merupakan makhluk mitos yang berbeda.
claims.quote: Though usually translated as “phoenix” in English, the fenghuang bird is a distinct mythical species with a different set of associations.

claims.statement: The fenghuang is said to appear in times of peace and prosperity.
claims.statement_id: Fenghuang dikisahkan muncul pada masa damai dan makmur, berbeda dari kisah kelahiran ulang phoenix.
claims.quote: The fenghuang, most noble of all feathered species, is said to appear only in times of peace and prosperity, so the creature is depicted frequently in works commissioned by imperial courts.

claims.statement: According to Herodotus, if the picture is accurate, the phoenix has partly golden and partly red plumage and is most like an eagle in shape and size.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Herodotus, jika gambarnya benar, bulu phoenix sebagian keemasan dan sebagian merah, dan bentuk serta ukurannya paling mirip elang.
claims.quote: Herodotus, Histories 2. 73 (trans. Godley) ... If the picture truly shows his size and appearance, his plumage is partly golden and partly red. He is most like an eagle in shape and size.

claims.statement: According to Ovid, one bird alone renews and re-begets itself, the Phoenix of Assyria, which feeds on balsam oil and the tears of frankincense.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Ovidius, hanya satu burung yang memperbarui dan melahirkan dirinya sendiri, yaitu phoenix dari Asyur, yang makan minyak balsam dan air mata kemenyan.
claims.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... But one alone, a bird, renews and re-begets itself--the Phoenix of Assyria, which feeds not upon seeds or verdure but the oils of balsam and the tears of frankincense.

claims.statement: In Ovid's account the phoenix builds a nest high on a palm, lines it with cassia, spikenard, myrrh and cinnamon, and ends its life there.
claims.statement_id: Dalam uraian Ovidius, phoenix membangun sarang di puncak pohon palem, melapisinya dengan kasia, narwastu, mur, dan serpihan kayu manis, lalu mengakhiri hidupnya di sana.
claims.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... builds a nest high on a lofty swaying palm; and lines the nest with cassia and spikenard and golden myrrh and shreds of cinnamon

claims.statement: In Ovid's account the young phoenix carries the nest across the sky to the Sun's city (Heliopolis in Egypt) and lays it before the doors of the Sun's temple.
claims.statement_id: Dalam uraian Ovidius, phoenix muda membawa sarang itu melintasi langit ke kota Matahari (Heliopolis di Mesir) dan meletakkannya di depan pintu kuil Matahari.
claims.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... carries it across the sky to reach the Sun's great city [i.e. Heliopolis in Egypt], and before the doors of the Sun's holy temple lays it down.

claims.statement: In Philostratus the sage Iarchas says the phoenix gives out rays of sunlight, shines with gold, resembles an eagle, and sits on a spice nest it makes at the springs of the Nile.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Philostratus, tokoh Iarkhas menyebut phoenix memancarkan sinar matahari, bercahaya keemasan, mirip elang, dan bertengger di sarang dari rempah di mata air Sungai Nil.
claims.quote: Philostratus, Life of Apollonius of Tyana 3. 49 (trans. Conybeare) ... he [the Indian sage Iarkhas (Iarchas) C1st A.D.] said ... it is unique in that it gives out rays of sunlight and shines with gold, in size and appearance like an eagle; and it sits upon the nest; which is made by it at the springs of the Nile out of spices.

claims.statement: In the Indian version reported by Philostratus, the phoenix being consumed in its nest sings funeral strains for itself.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kisah India dalam Philostratus, phoenix yang terbakar di sarangnya menyanyikan lagu duka bagi dirinya sendiri.
claims.quote: Philostratus, Life of Apollonius of Tyana 3. 49 (trans. Conybeare) ... The story of the Aigyptoi (Egyptians) about it, that it comes to Aigyptos, is testified to by the Indians also, but the latter add this touch to the story, that the Phoinix which is being consumed in its nest sings funeral strains for itself.

claims.statement: According to Claudian, the phoenix needs no food or drink; the sun's beam is its food and the sea's spray its drink.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Claudianus, phoenix tidak butuh makanan atau minuman; sinar matahari adalah makanannya dan percikan laut minumannya.
claims.quote: Claudian, The Phoenix ... It needs no food to satisfy hunger nor any drink to quench thirst; the sun's clear beam is its food, the sea's rare spray its drink

claims.statement: According to Claudian, this bird was never conceived and springs from no mortal seed; it is both its own father and son.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Claudianus, burung ini tidak pernah dikandung dan tidak berasal dari benih fana; ia sekaligus ayah dan putranya sendiri.
claims.quote: Claudian, The Phoenix ... Never was this bird conceived nor springs it from any mortal seed, itself is alike its own father and son

claims.statement: According to Aelian, the phoenix can reckon five hundred years without arithmetic, being a pupil of all-wise nature.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Aelianus, phoenix mampu menghitung lima ratus tahun tanpa ilmu hitung karena ia murid alam yang mahabijak.
claims.quote: Aelian, On Animals 6. 58 (trans. Scholfield) ... The Phoinix (Phoenix) knows how to reckon five hundred years without the aid of arithmetic, for it is a pupil of all-wise nature

claims.statement: In one account the phoenix builds a nest in Arabia and gives it the power of generation, so that a new phoenix rises from it after the bird's death.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu uraian, phoenix membangun sarang di Arabia dan memberinya daya melahirkan, sehingga setelah ia mati phoenix baru bangkit dari sarang itu.
claims.quote: he built a nest for himself in Arabia, to which he imparted the power of generation, so that after his death a new phoenix rose out of it.

claims.statement: Another version says only one phoenix lived at a time, and when it died a worm crept from its body and was developed into a new phoenix by the sun's heat.
claims.statement_id: Versi lain menyebut hanya satu phoenix hidup pada satu waktu, dan saat ia mati seekor cacing keluar dari tubuhnya lalu menjadi phoenix baru oleh panas matahari.
claims.quote: Others, again, state that only one Phoenix lived at a time, and that when he died a worm crept forth from his body, and was developed into a new Phoenix by the heat of the sun.

claims.statement: Another version says the phoenix built a pyre of spices, settled on it and died, then rose again from the decomposing body.
claims.statement_id: Versi lain menyebut phoenix membangun timbunan rempah, duduk di atasnya, lalu mati; dari tubuhnya yang membusuk ia bangkit kembali.
claims.quote: he built for himself a funeral pile, consisting of spices, settled upon it, and died. Out of the decomposing body he then rose again

claims.statement: Similar stories of marvellous birds occur in the East, such as the bird Simorg in Persia and the bird Semendar in India.
claims.statement_id: Kisah serupa tentang burung ajaib juga ada di Timur, misalnya burung Simorg di Persia dan burung Semendar di India.
claims.quote: Similar stories of marvellous birds occur in many parts of the East, as in Persia, the legend of the bird Simorg, and in India of the bird Semendar.

claims.statement: The new phoenix encases its parent in an egg of myrrh and conveys it to the great Egyptian temple of the Sun-God at Heliopolis.
claims.statement_id: Phoenix baru membungkus induknya dalam telur mur dan membawanya ke kuil besar dewa Matahari di Heliopolis, Mesir.
claims.quote: It then encased its parent in an egg of myrrh and conveyed it to the great Egyptian temple of the Sun-God in Heliopolis.

claims.statement: The phoenix is a legendary immortal bird that cyclically regenerates or is otherwise born again; it originates in Greek mythology and has analogues in many cultures.
claims.statement_id: Phoenix adalah burung legendaris yang abadi dan secara berulang memperbarui diri atau lahir kembali; berasal dari mitologi Yunani dan memiliki padanan di banyak budaya.
claims.quote: The phoenix is a legendary immortal bird that cyclically regenerates or is otherwise born again. Originating in Greek mythology, it has analogues in many cultures, such as Egyptian and Persian mythology.

claims.statement: The phoenix is associated with the Sun and obtains new life by rising from the ashes of its predecessor.
claims.statement_id: Phoenix dikaitkan dengan Matahari dan memperoleh hidup baru dengan bangkit dari abu pendahulunya.
claims.quote: Associated with the Sun, a phoenix obtains new life by rising from the ashes of its predecessor.

claims.statement: The Latin word comes from Greek φοῖνιξ (phoinix), first attested in Mycenaean Greek as po-ni-ke, which probably meant "griffin" though it might have meant "palm tree".
claims.statement_id: Kata Latin phoenix berasal dari kata Yunani φοῖνιξ (phoinix), yang pertama kali tercatat dalam bahasa Yunani Mikene sebagai po-ni-ke, kemungkinan berarti "griffin" atau mungkin "pohon palem".
claims.quote: The Latin word comes from Greek φοῖνιξ (phoinix). The Greek word is first attested in the Mycenaean Greek po-ni-ke, which probably meant "griffin", though it might have meant "palm tree".

claims.statement: The Greek word is probably a borrowing from a West Semitic word for madder, a red dye made from Rubia tinctorum.
claims.statement_id: Kata Yunani itu kemungkinan pinjaman dari kata Semit Barat untuk madder, pewarna merah dari Rubia tinctorum.
claims.quote: That word is probably a borrowing from a West Semitic word for madder, a red dye made from Rubia tinctorum.

claims.statement: The earliest clear mention of the phoenix in ancient Greek literature occurs in a fragment of the Precepts of Chiron, attributed to the 8th-century BC poet Hesiod.
claims.statement_id: Penyebutan phoenix yang paling awal dan jelas dalam sastra Yunani kuno ada pada fragmen Precepts of Chiron yang dikaitkan dengan penyair Hesiodos dari abad ke-8 SM.
claims.quote: the earliest clear mention of the phoenix in ancient Greek literature occurs in a fragment of the Precepts of Chiron, attributed to 8th-century BC Greek poet Hesiod.

claims.statement: In that fragment the phoenix outlives nine ravens, but the Nymphs, daughters of Zeus, outlive ten phoenixes.
claims.statement_id: Dalam fragmen itu, phoenix hidup lebih lama daripada sembilan gagak, tetapi para Nimfa putri Zeus hidup lebih lama daripada sepuluh phoenix.
claims.quote: while the phoenix outlives nine ravens, but we, the rich-haired Nymphs daughters of Zeus the aegis-holder, outlive ten phoenixes.

claims.statement: In the 19th century it was found that Egyptians at Heliopolis had venerated the Bennu, a solar bird similar in some respects to the Greek phoenix, though the Egyptian sources are often problematic and open to varied interpretations.
claims.statement_id: Pada abad ke-19 ditemukan bahwa orang Mesir di Heliopolis memuliakan Bennu, burung matahari yang mirip phoenix Yunani dalam beberapa hal, tetapi sumber Mesirnya sering bermasalah dan dapat ditafsirkan beragam.
claims.quote: the discovery that Egyptians in Heliopolis had venerated the Bennu, a solar bird similar in some respects to the Greek phoenix. However, the Egyptian sources regarding the bennu are often problematic and open to a variety of interpretations.

claims.statement: The phoenix is often shown with a halo in ancient and medieval literature and medieval art, emphasising its connection with the Sun.
claims.statement_id: Phoenix sering digambarkan dengan lingkaran cahaya dalam sastra kuno dan abad pertengahan serta seni abad pertengahan, menekankan kaitannya dengan Matahari.
claims.quote: The phoenix is often depicted in ancient and medieval literature and medieval art endowed with a halo, emphasising the bird's connection with the Sun.

claims.statement: The phoenix was generally believed to be colourful and vibrant, but sources give no clear consensus about its exact colouration.
claims.statement_id: Phoenix umumnya dipercaya berwarna-warni, tetapi sumber-sumber tidak sepakat soal warna persisnya.
claims.quote: Although the phoenix was generally believed to be colourful and vibrant, sources provide no clear consensus about its exact colouration.

claims.statement: Pliny states that a purported phoenix seen in Egypt in 47 AD was brought to the capital and exhibited in the Comitium.
claims.statement_id: Plinius menyatakan seekor phoenix yang diklaim terlihat di Mesir pada 47 M dibawa ke ibu kota dan dipamerkan di Comitium.
claims.quote: Pliny states that a purported phoenix seen in Egypt in 47 AD was brought to the capital and exhibited in the Comitium

claims.statement: Pliny added that nobody would doubt that this phoenix was a fabrication.
claims.statement_id: Plinius menambahkan bahwa tak seorang pun akan meragukan bahwa phoenix itu rekayasa.
claims.quote: Pliny states that a purported phoenix seen in Egypt in 47 AD ... though he added that "nobody would doubt that this phoenix was a fabrication".

claims.statement: Tacitus recorded that the phoenix appeared in 34 AD.
claims.statement_id: Tacitus mencatat bahwa phoenix muncul pada 34 M.
claims.quote: A second recording of the phoenix was made by Tacitus, who said that the phoenix had appeared instead in 34 AD

claims.statement: Scholars note analogues of the phoenix in many cultures, including the Hindu garuda and bherunda, the Slavic firebird and Raróg, and the Persian simorgh.
claims.statement_id: Para sarjana mencatat padanan phoenix di banyak budaya, antara lain garuda dan bherunda Hindu, burung api dan Raróg Slavia, serta simorgh Persia.
claims.quote: These analogues include the Hindu garuda (गरुड) and bherunda (भेरुण्ड), the Slavic firebird (жар-птица) and Raróg, the Persian simorgh (سیمرغ)

claims.statement: The Harry Potter series features a phoenix named Fawkes, Professor Dumbledore's loyal pet, and a secret society called the Order of the Phoenix.
claims.statement_id: Seri Harry Potter menampilkan phoenix bernama Fawkes, hewan peliharaan setia Profesor Dumbledore, serta perkumpulan rahasia bernama Order of the Phoenix.
claims.quote: The Harry Potter series features a phoenix named Fawkes, described as Professor Dumbledore's loyal pet, and also a secret society called the Order of the Phoenix

claims.statement: Uranus or Ouranos is the personification of the sky in Greek mythology.
claims.statement_id: Uranus atau Ouranos adalah personifikasi langit dalam mitologi Yunani.
claims.quote: Uranus (also spelt Ouranos) is the personification of heaven and the sky in Greek mythology.

claims.statement: Uranus is a primordial sky god.
claims.statement_id: Uranus digolongkan sebagai dewa purba langit.
claims.quote: OURANOS (Uranus) was the primordial god (protogenos) of the sky.

claims.statement: Gaia gave birth to Uranus and chose him as her equal.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Gaia melahirkan Uranus dan menjadikannya pasangannya.
claims.quote: Gaia (Earth) gave birth to Uranus and chose him to be her equal.

claims.statement: Gaia and Uranus parented the Titans, Cyclopes, and Hecatoncheires.
claims.statement_id: Gaia dan Uranus melahirkan para Titan, Cyclopes, dan Hecatoncheires.
claims.quote: She lay with him, resulting in the birth of the twelve Titans, the three Cyclopes and the three Hecatoncheires.

claims.statement: Uranus hid his children within the earth.
claims.statement_id: Uranus menyembunyikan anak-anaknya di dalam bumi.
claims.quote: Uranus hated his and Gaia's children and hid them deep beneath the earth so that they would stay out of his sight.

claims.statement: Gaia gave Cronus a sickle to confront Uranus.
claims.statement_id: Gaia memberikan sabit kepada Cronus untuk melawan Uranus.
claims.quote: Gaia made a sickle out of grey adamant, gave it to Cronus, and hid him in her bed chamber.

claims.statement: Cronus castrated Uranus with the sickle.
claims.statement_id: Cronus mengebiri Uranus dengan sabit.
claims.quote: Cronus took his chance and struck out with the sickle, castrating Uranus' genitals.

claims.statement: Uranus's blood falling on Gaia led to the birth of Erinyes, Giants, and Meliae.
claims.statement_id: Darah Uranus yang jatuh ke Gaia melahirkan Erinyes, para raksasa, dan Meliae.
claims.quote: As the blood fell, it impregnated Gaia, who gave birth to the Erinyes (the Furies), the Giants and the Meliae (tree nymphs).

claims.statement: In this account, Aphrodite was born from sea foam.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah itu, Aphrodite lahir dari buih di laut.
claims.quote: White foam surrounded it, and from it, the goddess Aphrodite was born in Cythera (Kythira).

claims.statement: Caelus is Uranus's Roman counterpart.
claims.statement_id: Caelus adalah padanan Romawi Uranus.
claims.quote: His Roman counterpart is Caelus.

claims.statement: The Greeks imagined the sky as a solid brass dome decorated with stars, its edges resting on the outermost limits of the flat earth; Ouranos was the literal sky, as his consort Gaia was the earth.
claims.statement_id: Orang Yunani membayangkan langit sebagai kubah perunggu padat bertabur bintang yang tepinya bertumpu pada batas terjauh bumi yang datar; Ouranos adalah langit itu sendiri, sebagaimana pasangannya Gaia adalah bumi.
claims.quote: The Greeks imagined the sky as a solid dome of brass, decorated with stars, whose edges descended to rest upon the outermost limits of the flat earth. Ouranos was the literal sky, just as his consort Gaia (Gaea) was the earth.

claims.statement: Ouranos and Gaia had twelve sons and six daughters; he locked the eldest, the giant Cyclopes and Hecatoncheires, away inside the belly of Earth.
claims.statement_id: Ouranos dan Gaia memiliki dua belas putra dan enam putri; ia mengurung anak tertua, para Kyklopes dan Hekatonkheires yang raksasa, di dalam perut Bumi.
claims.quote: Ouranos and Gaia had twelve sons and six daughters. He locked the eldest of these--the giant Kyklopes (Cyclopes) and Hekatonkheires (Hecatoncheires)--away inside the belly of Earth.

claims.statement: In this account four of the children took positions at the corners of the world to seize their father while Kronos, in the centre, castrated Ouranos with an adamantine sickle.
claims.statement_id: Menurut uraian ini, empat dari anak-anak itu berjaga di sudut dunia untuk menangkap ayah mereka, sementara Kronos di tengah mengebiri Ouranos dengan sabit adamantin.
claims.quote: Four of these positioned themselves at the corners of the world, ready to grasp their father as he descended to lie with Earth, while the fifth, Kronos (Cronus), took his place in the centre and there castrated Ouranos with an adamantine sickle.

claims.statement: Ouranos prophesied the fall of the Titans and their punishment for their crimes, a prophecy fulfilled when Zeus deposed the five brothers and cast them into the pit of Tartaros.
claims.statement_id: Ouranos menubuatkan kejatuhan para Titan dan hukuman atas kejahatan mereka; Zeus menggenapi nubuat itu dengan menggulingkan lima bersaudara dan melemparkan mereka ke jurang Tartaros.
claims.quote: Ouranos prophesied the fall of the Titanes and the punishments they would suffer for their crimes--a prophecy brought to fruition by Zeus who deposed the five brothers and cast them into the pit of Tartaros.

claims.statement: Ouranos does not appear in early Greek art, but Egyptian depictions of the sky-goddess Nut show how he was imagined: a gigantic, star-spangled man with long limbs, resting on all fours.
claims.statement_id: Ouranos tidak muncul dalam seni Yunani awal, tetapi penggambaran Mesir tentang dewi langit Nut menunjukkan bagaimana ia dibayangkan: pria raksasa bertabur bintang berlengan dan berkaki panjang yang bertumpu pada keempat anggota badan.
claims.quote: Ouranos does not appear in early Greek art but Egyptian depictions of their sky-goddess Nut demonstrate how he was imagined--as a gigantic, star-spangled man with long arms and legs, resting on all fours

claims.statement: In the Roman era he was often depicted as Aion, god of eternal time, as a man holding the zodiac-wheel and standing above the reclining Gaia.
claims.statement_id: Pada masa Romawi ia sering digambarkan sebagai Aion, dewa waktu abadi, berwujud pria yang memegang roda zodiak dan berdiri di atas Gaia yang berbaring.
claims.quote: In the Roman era he was often depicted as Aion, god of eternal time, in the form of a man holding the zodiac-wheel, standing above the reclining Gaia (Earth).

claims.statement: According to the writer of the War of the Titans, Ouranos was the son of Aither.
claims.statement_id: Menurut penulis War of the Titans, Ouranos adalah putra Aither.
claims.quote: According to the writer of the War of the Titans Ouranos (Uranus) was the son of Aither (Aether).

claims.statement: In Orphism, Phanes gave birth to Nyx (Night), and then Nyx bore Gaia and Uranus with Phanes.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Orfisme, Phanes melahirkan Nyx (Malam), lalu Nyx melahirkan Gaia dan Uranus bersama Phanes.
claims.quote: In Orphism, the world began with Chronos (Time). ... Phanes gave birth to Nyx (Night), then Nyx bore Gaia and Uranus with Phanes.

claims.statement: Although there is barely any surviving evidence of worship of Uranus, one Orphic hymn is dedicated to him.
claims.statement_id: Meski nyaris tidak ada bukti ibadah kepada Uranus yang bertahan, ia memiliki satu himne Orfik yang dipersembahkan untuknya.
claims.quote: Although there is barely any surviving evidence of worship to Uranus, he does have an Orphic hymn dedicated to him.

claims.statement: Uranus, along with Gaia and Styx, was often the witness to the oaths of the gods.
claims.statement_id: Uranus bersama Gaia dan Styx sering menjadi saksi sumpah para dewa.
claims.quote: Uranus, along with Gaia and Styx, was often the witness to the oaths of the gods.

claims.statement: According to the Theogony, Tartarus, Earth and the heavens are equally far apart; an anvil falling from Uranus would take nine days and nights to reach Gaia.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Theogony, jarak antara Tartarus, Bumi (Gaia), dan langit (Uranus) sama; sebuah landasan yang jatuh dari Uranus butuh sembilan hari sembilan malam untuk mencapai Gaia.
claims.quote: According to the Theogony, there is an equal distance between Tartarus (the infernal regions), Earth (Gaia), and the heavens (Uranus). Therefore, an anvil falling from Uranus would take nine days and nights to reach Gaia

claims.statement: Uranus lost power to Cronus but warned him that he too would be overthrown by his son.
claims.statement_id: Uranus kehilangan kekuasaan kepada Cronus tetapi memperingatkannya bahwa ia pun akan digulingkan oleh putranya.
claims.quote: Uranus lost power to Cronus but warned him that he, too, would face being overthrown by his son.

claims.statement: A desperate Rhea asked Uranus and Gaia for help, and they helped her flee to Crete, where Zeus was born.
claims.statement_id: Rhea yang putus asa meminta bantuan Uranus dan Gaia, dan mereka membantunya melarikan diri ke Kreta, tempat Zeus lahir.
claims.quote: A desperate Rhea approached Uranus and Gaia for help, and they helped her run away to Crete, where Zeus was born.

claims.statement: Uranus and Gaia told Zeus that Metis would have a strong, wise daughter and a son who would overthrow his father to become king of gods and men.
claims.statement_id: Uranus dan Gaia memberi tahu Zeus bahwa Metis akan melahirkan seorang putri yang kuat dan bijak serta seorang putra yang akan menggulingkan ayahnya menjadi raja para dewa dan manusia.
claims.quote: After Zeus married his first wife, Metis, Uranus and Gaia informed him that Metis would have a daughter who was strong and wise like her father and a son who would overthrow his father to become king of the gods and men.

claims.statement: According to World History Encyclopedia, the myth closely follows the Uranus-Cronus-Zeus succession myth in Hesiod's Theogony, and Anu, king of Heaven, can clearly be identified as Uranus.
claims.statement_id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, mitos itu sangat mirip dengan mitos suksesi Uranus-Cronus-Zeus dalam Theogony Hesiod, dan Anu, raja Langit, dapat jelas dikenali sebagai Uranus.
claims.quote: The myth closely follows the Uranus-Cronus-Zeus succession myth found in Hesiod's Theogony. Anu, the king of Heaven, can clearly be identified as Uranus.

claims.statement: Tablets found in excavations at the village of Boĝazköy recount the Hittite story of the storm god Teššub's rise to power and the attempts to overthrow him.
claims.statement_id: Tablet yang ditemukan dalam penggalian di desa Boĝazköy menceritakan kisah Het tentang kebangkitan dewa badai Teššub dan upaya menggulingkannya.
claims.quote: During the 20th-century excavations in the village of Boĝazköy (Turkey), a set of tablets were discovered that recounted the Hittite story of the storm god Teššub's rise to power and the attempts to overthrow him.

claims.statement: What is considered a Phoenician version of the succession myth is recorded by Herennius Philo (Philo of Byblos, 1st or 2nd century CE).
claims.statement_id: Versi mitos suksesi yang dianggap versi Fenisia dicatat oleh Herennius Philo (Philo dari Byblos, abad ke-1 atau ke-2 M).
claims.quote: What is considered a Phoenician version of the succession myth is recorded by Herennius Philo (aka Philo of Byblos, l. 1st or 2nd century CE).

claims.statement: In this succession version, Epigeios, later named Uranus, replaced his father as king and married his sister Ge (Gaia).
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi suksesi ini, Epigeios, yang kemudian dinamai Uranus, menggantikan ayahnya sebagai raja dan menikahi saudarinya, Ge (Gaia).
claims.quote: Together they have a son named Epigeios, who would later be named Uranus, and a daughter called Ge (Gaia). After his father's death, Epigeios (Uranus) replaced him as king and married his sister, Ge.

claims.statement: In that version, Cronus emasculated Uranus in the 32nd year of his reign.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi itu, pada tahun ke-32 pemerintahannya Cronus mengebiri Uranus.
claims.quote: During the 32nd year of his reign, Cronus emasculated Uranus.

claims.statement: The astronomer Johann Elert Bode suggested that the planet be called Uranus in honour of the primordial deity.
claims.statement_id: Astronom Johann Elert Bode mengusulkan agar planet itu dinamai Uranus untuk menghormati dewa purba tersebut.
claims.quote: it was fellow astronomer Johann Elert Bode (1747-1826) who suggested that it be called Uranus in honour of the primordial deity

claims.statement: The planet Uranus was discovered in 1781 by the British-German astronomer William Herschel.
claims.statement_id: Planet Uranus ditemukan pada 1781 oleh astronom Inggris-Jerman William Herschel.
claims.quote: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun and the third largest of the planets. It was discovered in 1781 by the British-German astronomer William Herschel (1738-1822)

claims.statement: In his Theogony, Hesiod (700 BCE) writes that Gaia bore Uranus (Heaven) along with Pontus (the Sea) and Ourea (the Mountains).
claims.statement_id: Dalam Theogony-nya, Hesiod (700 SM) menulis bahwa Gaia melahirkan Uranus (Langit) bersama Pontus (Laut) dan Ourea (Pegunungan).
claims.quote: In his Theogony, Hesiod (700 BCE) writes that Gaia, the personification of Earth, gave birth to Uranus (Heaven), along with Pontus (the Sea) and Ourea (the Mountains).

claims.statement: Orphism was a religious movement that rose to prominence during the 6th century BCE.
claims.statement_id: Orfisme adalah gerakan keagamaan yang menonjol pada abad ke-6 SM.
claims.quote: Orphism was a religious movement that rose to prominence during the 6th century BCE.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, Earth first bore starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side and be an ever-sure abiding place for the blessed gods.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi pertama-tama melahirkan Langit berbintang, setara dengannya, untuk menutupinya di semua sisi dan menjadi tempat tinggal yang selalu aman bagi para dewa yang diberkati.
claims.quote: And Earth first bore starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side, and to be an ever-sure abiding-place for the blessed gods.

claims.statement: Hesiod writes that Earth afterwards lay with Heaven and bore Oceanus, Coeus, Crius, Hyperion, Iapetus, Theia, Rhea, Themis, Mnemosyne, Phoebe and Tethys.
claims.statement_id: Hesiod menulis bahwa Gaia kemudian berbaring bersama Langit dan melahirkan Oceanus, Coeus, Crius, Hyperion, Iapetus, Theia, Rhea, Themis, Mnemosyne, Phoebe, dan Tethys.
claims.quote: But afterwards she lay with Heaven and bore deep-swirling Oceanus, Coeus and Crius and Hyperion and Iapetus, [135] Theia and Rhea, Themis and Mnemosyne and gold-crowned Phoebe and lovely Tethys.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, the most terrible children of Earth and Heaven were hated by their father from the first; as each was born he hid it in a secret place of Earth and would not let it come up into the light, and Heaven rejoiced in his evil doing.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, anak-anak terdahsyat Bumi dan Langit dibenci ayah mereka sejak awal; setiap kali seorang lahir ia menyembunyikannya di tempat rahasia di Bumi dan melarangnya naik ke terang, dan Langit bersukacita atas perbuatan jahatnya.
claims.quote: For of all the children that were born of Earth and Heaven, [155] these were the most terrible, and they were hated by their own father from the first. And he used to hide them all away in a secret place of Earth so soon as each was born, and would not suffer them to come up into the light: and Heaven rejoiced in his evil doing.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, Earth made the element of grey flint into a great sickle and told her plan to her sons.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi membentuk sabit besar dari unsur batu api kelabu dan menyampaikan rencananya kepada putra-putranya.
claims.quote: Forthwith she made the element of grey flint and shaped a great sickle, and told her plan to her dear sons.

claims.statement: In Hesiod, Heaven came bringing night and longing for love and spread himself upon Earth; his son from his ambush lopped off his father's members with the long jagged sickle and cast them behind him.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Hesiod, Langit datang membawa malam dan merindukan cinta lalu merebahkan diri di atas Bumi; putranya dari penyergapan memotong anggota tubuh ayahnya dengan sabit panjang bergerigi dan melemparkannya ke belakang.
claims.quote: And Heaven came, bringing on night and longing for love, and he lay about Earth spreading himself full upon her. ... Then the son from his ambush stretched forth his left hand and in his right took the great long sickle [180] with jagged teeth, and swiftly lopped off his own father's members and cast them away to fall behind him.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, Earth received all the bloody drops and as the seasons turned bore the strong Erinyes, the Giants in gleaming armour with long spears, and the Nymphs called Meliae.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi menerima semua tetes darah itu dan seiring musim ia melahirkan Erinyes yang kuat, para Raksasa berbaju zirah gemerlap bertombak panjang, dan Nimfa yang disebut Meliae.
claims.quote: for all the bloody drops that gushed forth Earth received, and as the seasons moved round [185] she bore the strong Erinyes and the great Giants with gleaming armour, holding long spears in their hands and the Nymphs whom they call Meliae

claims.statement: According to Hesiod, great Heaven called his sons Titans (Strainers) in reproach, saying they strained and did presumptuously a fearful deed, and that vengeance for it would come afterwards.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod, Langit yang agung menjuluki putra-putranya "Titan" (Para Penegang) sebagai celaan, karena mereka berbuat lancang suatu perbuatan mengerikan, dan ia berkata bahwa pembalasan akan datang kemudian.
claims.quote: But these sons whom he begot himself great Heaven used to call Titans (Strainers) in reproach, for he said that they strained and did presumptuously [210] a fearful deed, and that vengeance for it would come afterwards.

claims.statement: No cult addressed directly to Uranus survived into classical times, and Uranus is not among the usual themes of Greek painted pottery.
claims.statement_id: Tidak ada kultus yang ditujukan langsung kepada Uranus yang bertahan hingga masa klasik, dan Uranus tidak termasuk tema lazim keramik lukis Yunani.
claims.quote: However, no cult addressed directly to Uranus survived into classical times, and Uranus does not appear among the usual themes of Greek painted pottery.

claims.statement: Uranus is the personification of the sky and one of the Greek primordial deities; according to Hesiod he was the son and husband of Gaia, with whom he fathered the first generation of Titans.
claims.statement_id: Uranus adalah personifikasi langit dan salah satu dewa purba Yunani; menurut Hesiod ia putra sekaligus suami Gaia, yang bersamanya menurunkan generasi pertama Titan.
claims.quote: is the personification of the sky and one of the Greek primordial deities. According to Hesiod, Uranus was the son and husband of Gaia (Earth), with whom he fathered the first generation of Titans.

claims.statement: Most linguists trace the etymology of the name Οὐρανός to a Proto-Greek form *Worsanós.
claims.statement_id: Kebanyakan ahli bahasa menelusuri etimologi nama Οὐρανός ke bentuk Proto-Yunani *Worsanós.
claims.quote: Most linguists trace the etymology of the name Οὐρανός to a Proto-Greek form *Worsanós

claims.statement: The basic Indo-European root makes Ouranos the "rain-maker" or the "lord of rain".
claims.statement_id: Akar kata Indo-Eropa dasarnya menjadikan Ouranos "pembuat hujan" atau "penguasa hujan".
claims.quote: making Ouranos the "rain-maker", or the "lord of rain".

claims.statement: Georges Dumézil (1934) identified Uranus with the Vedic deity Váruṇa, but the etymological equation is now considered untenable.
claims.statement_id: Georges Dumézil (1934) mengidentifikasi Uranus dengan dewa Weda Váruṇa, tetapi persamaan etimologis itu kini dianggap tidak dapat dipertahankan.
claims.quote: Of some importance in the comparative study of Indo-European mythology is the contested identification by Georges Dumézil (1934) of Uranus with the Vedic deity Váruṇa (Mitanni Aruna), god of the sky and waters, but the etymological equation is now considered untenable.

claims.statement: Uranus is identified on the Gigantomachy frieze of the Pergamon Altar, bearded and winged, fighting the Giants with a sword.
claims.statement_id: Uranus diidentifikasi pada relief Gigantomachy di Altar Pergamon, berjenggot dan bersayap, melawan para Raksasa dengan pedang.
claims.quote: He is, however, identified on the Gigantomachy frieze on the Pergamon Altar, bearded and winged, fighting against the Giants with a sword

claims.statement: After his castration, Uranus recedes into the background.
claims.statement_id: Setelah dikebiri, peran Uranus surut ke latar belakang.
claims.quote: After his castration, Uranus recedes into the background.

claims.statement: Hanuman is an animal-formed figure in Indian mythology revered as a god.
claims.statement_id: Hanuman adalah sosok mitologi India berwujud hewan yang dipuja sebagai dewa.
claims.quote: Hanuman is one of several zoomorphic characters in Indian mythology, but is the only wholly animal figure who is revered as a god today.

claims.statement: Hanuman is a monkey-bodied deity, Rama's companion, and an exemplar of devotion.
claims.statement_id: Hanuman adalah dewa bertubuh kera, pendamping Rama, dan teladan bakti.
claims.quote: a deity with the body of a monkey; a companion of the deity Rama and an exemplar of self-discipline and devotion.

claims.statement: Mythic texts describe Hanuman as the Wind God's monkey child with strength and Vedic learning.
claims.statement_id: Teks mitos menggambarkan Hanuman sebagai anak dewa angin yang kuat dan menguasai Weda.
claims.quote: The mythic texts speak of him as a monkey child of the Wind God, as possessing enormous strength, keen intellect and a mastery over the Vedas and other branches of learning.

claims.statement: Hanuman is devoted to Rama and can assume any form.
claims.statement_id: Hanuman mengabdi kepada Rama dan dapat mengambil berbagai wujud.
claims.quote: He is also an unquestioning devotee of Rama, the hero of the epic Ramayana, and has the ability to take on any form he wishes.

claims.statement: Hanuman flies over the sea to locate Sita and report back to Rama.
claims.statement_id: Hanuman terbang menyeberangi lautan untuk menemukan Sita dan membawa kabar kepada Rama.
claims.quote: He is the one who flies across the oceans (he is Wind's child), locates the exact place where Sita is imprisoned and brings this information back to Rama.

claims.statement: Unable to identify the healing herbs, Hanuman carries the whole mountain to the battlefield.
claims.statement_id: Ketika tidak bisa mengenali ramuan penyembuh, Hanuman membawa seluruh gunung ke medan perang.
claims.quote: Being unable to identify the exact four herbs that the physician had described, Hanuman uproots the entire mountain and carries it back to the battlefield.

claims.statement: Hanuman can change form and alter his size.
claims.statement_id: Hanuman dapat mengubah wujud dan ukuran tubuhnya.
claims.quote: He is also a shapeshifter who can increase and decrease his body size at will.

claims.statement: Hanuman remains worshiped as a god in parts of India.
claims.statement_id: Hanuman masih dipuja sebagai dewa di berbagai wilayah India.
claims.quote: Hanuman is worshipped as a god in several parts of India today.

claims.statement: The Met notes Hanuman's veneration for humility and loyalty, with devotees seeking strength and courage.
claims.statement_id: Menurut The Met, umat memuja Hanuman atas kerendahan hati dan kesetiaannya serta mengharapkan kekuatan dan keberanian.
claims.quote: Hanuman is venerated across India on account of his humility and loyalty, and devotees believe worshipping him imbues them with physical energy, fearlessness, and mental enlightenment.

claims.statement: Hanuman amulets are believed to protect their wearers and bring well-being.
claims.statement_id: Jimat bergambar Hanuman dipercaya melindungi pemakainya dan membawa kesejahteraan.
claims.quote: Amulets featuring large depictions of Hanuman protect the wearer, providing prosperity, peace, and good health.

claims.statement: While inside the demon fort searching for Sita, Hanuman sets the whole place on fire and warns Ravana of an impending attack unless Sita is returned unharmed.
claims.statement_id: Saat berada di benteng para iblis untuk mencari Sita, Hanuman membakar seluruh tempat itu dan memperingatkan Rahwana tentang serangan yang akan datang kecuali Sita dikembalikan dengan selamat.
claims.quote: While within the demon fort on his quest for Sita, he sets the entire place on fire and warns Ravana about an impending attack unless Sita is returned unharmed.

claims.statement: In the Rama-Ravana battle Hanuman kills several demon generals and also brings Rama's brother back to life.
claims.statement_id: Dalam pertempuran Rama-Rahwana, Hanuman membunuh beberapa jenderal iblis dan juga menghidupkan kembali saudara Rama.
claims.quote: During the Rama-Ravana battle, Hanuman not only kills several demon generals but also brings Rama's brother back to life.

claims.statement: The battle rages in Lanka while the Himalayas are far to the north and the herbs are needed before dawn; Hanuman leaps into the air, flies north at lightning speed and alights atop the Himalayas.
claims.statement_id: Pertempuran berkecamuk di Lanka sementara Himalaya jauh di utara, dan ramuan dibutuhkan sebelum fajar; Hanuman melompat ke udara, terbang ke utara secepat kilat, dan mendarat di puncak Himalaya.
claims.quote: The catch? The battle is raging on in Lanka, across the southernmost tip of the country, while the Himalayas are far up north, and the herbs are needed within the next few hours, before the new day dawns. Hanuman leaps up into the air, flies northwards at lightning speed, and alights atop the Himalayas.

claims.statement: The group of monkeys helped Rama build a bridge across the sea and cross with a monkey army that stormed the demon stronghold and freed Sita.
claims.statement_id: Kelompok kera itu membantu Rama membangun jembatan menyeberangi laut dan menyeberang bersama pasukan kera yang berhasil menyerbu benteng iblis dan membebaskan Sita.
claims.quote: This monkey group was instrumental in giving Rama key information about Sita. They helped him build a bridge across the seas, and cross over with a monkey army that successfully stormed the demon stronghold and freed Sita.

claims.statement: From his father, the Wind God, Hanuman inherits his might and speed.
claims.statement_id: Dari ayahnya, Dewa Angin, Hanuman mewarisi kekuatan dan kecepatannya.
claims.quote: From his father, the Wind God, he inherits his might and speed.

claims.statement: In the epic Hanuman is described as having an extremely pleasant face, perfect diction, elegant speech and faultless manners, and as knowing the three Vedas.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wiracarita itu Hanuman digambarkan berwajah sangat menyenangkan, berdiksi sempurna, bertutur santun, dan bersopan santun tanpa cela, serta menguasai tiga Weda.
claims.quote: Hanuman is described in the epic as one of extremely pleasant visage, perfect diction, elegant speech, and faultless manners. He is also described as being knowledgeable in the three Vedas.

claims.statement: In the Mahabharata, Bhima cannot move even a whisker of an old monkey's tail; the monkey turns out to be Hanuman, the mightiest being on earth.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Mahabharata, Bhima tak mampu menggeser sehelai pun ekor seekor kera tua yang ternyata adalah Hanuman, makhluk terkuat di bumi.
claims.quote: One of the princes in the Mahabharat is also a son of the Wind God and it is to him that Hanuman makes his only appearance in this epic. This prince, named Bhima, was as mighty as the wind ... he could not move even a whisker of the tail. It transpired that the monkey was none other than Hanuman, the mightiest being on earth.

claims.statement: As a mark of affection to Bhima, Hanuman agreed to reside on the flag of the chariot of Bhima's younger brother Arjuna.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai tanda kasih kepada Bhima, Hanuman setuju tinggal di bendera kereta Arjuna, adik Bhima.
claims.quote: As a mark of affection to Bhima, Hanuman agreed to reside on the flag of Bhima's younger brother Arjuna's chariot.

claims.statement: Hanuman is the child of the Wind God and the princess Anjana; he is called by his mother's name, Anjaneya, as often as by his father's.
claims.statement_id: Hanuman adalah anak Dewa Angin dan putri Anjana; ia disebut dengan nama ibunya, Anjaneya, sesering nama ayahnya.
claims.quote: Hanuman is the child of the Wind God and the princess Anjana. He is referred to by his metronymic, Anjaneya, as often as his patronymic

claims.statement: According to the Puranas, the couple prayed to Shiva for a son, and Hanuman was born from an aspect of Shiva through the agency of the Wind God.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Purana, pasangan itu berdoa kepada Shiva memohon seorang putra, dan Hanuman lahir dari aspek Shiva melalui perantaraan Dewa Angin.
claims.quote: The various Puranas say that Anjana was married to the monkey chief Kesari. The couple prayed to Shiva for a son, and Hanuman was born to them from an aspect of Shiva, through the agency of the Wind God.

claims.statement: Hanuman has two patronyms: Vayu-putra (Wind's son) and Kesari-nandan (Kesari's son).
claims.statement_id: Hanuman memiliki dua nama keturunan: Vayu-putra (putra Angin) dan Kesari-nandan (putra Kesari).
claims.quote: Thus, Hanuman has two patronyms: Vayu-putra (Wind's son) as well as Kesari-nandan (Kesari's son).

claims.statement: Hanuman mistook the sun for a ripe fruit and leapt into the air to grab it.
claims.statement_id: Hanuman mengira matahari adalah buah matang dan melompat ke udara untuk menyambarnya.
claims.quote: Hanuman mistook the sun itself to be a ripe fruit and leapt up in the air to grab it.

claims.statement: According to this story the thunderbolt hit its target, the monkey child's chin was disfigured, and he came to be known as Hanuman (hanu = chin; man = having), "he of the [broken] chin".
claims.statement_id: Menurut kisah ini petir mengenai sasarannya, dagu anak kera itu cacat, dan ia dikenal sebagai Hanuman (hanu = dagu; man = memiliki), yakni "yang berdagu [patah]".
claims.quote: the infallible thunderbolt hit its target, the monkey child got his chin disfigured, and came to be known as Hanuman (hanu = chin; man = of, with, bearing, having; hanu+man=he of [broken] chin).

claims.statement: In this story Hanuman tells the king of the gods that he is unslayable, being born of Shiva.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah ini, Hanuman berseru kepada raja para dewa bahwa ia tak dapat dibunuh karena lahir dari Shiva.
claims.quote: Do you not know, King, that I am unslayable? I am born of Shiva, how can your thunderbolt do anything to me?

claims.statement: The Puranas also say Surya, the Sun God, taught Hanuman the Vedas and all other branches of learning, which he learnt by trotting alongside the Sun's chariot.
claims.statement_id: Purana juga menyebut Surya, dewa Matahari, mengajarkan Weda dan segala cabang ilmu kepada Hanuman, yang belajar sambil berlari di samping kereta Matahari.
claims.quote: The Puranas also tell us that Hanuman was taught the Vedas and all other branches of learning by Sun God himself, Surya. He learnt his lessons by trotting alongside the Sun's chariot as it moved across the sky.

claims.statement: In the 16th century CE the poet Tulsidas retold the Ramayana in Awadhi and composed several hymns, including the Hanuman Chalisa, still recited by thousands today.
claims.statement_id: Pada abad ke-16 M, penyair Tulsidas menceritakan ulang Ramayana dalam bahasa Awadhi dan menggubah beberapa himne, termasuk Hanuman Chalisa yang masih dilantunkan ribuan orang.
claims.quote: During the 16th CE, a poet called Tulsidas retold the Ramayana in the vernacular Awadhi language (rather than the academic Sanskrit) and also composed several hymns to the gods. One such hymn, the Hanuman Chalisa, continues to be recited today by thousands of people.

claims.statement: The canticle of about 40 verses celebrates the qualities Hanuman came to signify over the centuries: strength, devotion, celibacy and righteousness.
claims.statement_id: Kidung sekitar 40 bait itu memuliakan sifat-sifat yang dilambangkan Hanuman selama berabad-abad: kekuatan, bakti, selibat, dan kebenaran.
claims.quote: This canticle of about 40 verses celebrates all of the qualities that Hanuman came to signify over the centuries: strength, devotion, celibacy, and righteousness.

claims.statement: In the translated extract of the Hanuman Chalisa, demons and ghosts do not come near when they hear the mighty one's name, and diseases die and sorrows disappear for one who constantly chants Hanuman's name.
claims.statement_id: Dalam terjemahan petikan Hanuman Chalisa, setan dan hantu tidak mendekat bila mendengar nama sang perkasa, penyakit lenyap dan duka sirna bagi yang terus melafalkan nama Hanuman.
claims.quote: In an extract from the Hanuman Chalisa ... Demons and ghosts do not come near If they hear the mighty one's name Diseases die, sorrows disappear If one constantly chants Hanuman's name

claims.statement: A small shrine to Hanuman is almost de rigueur in police stations and wrestling clubs across India, especially the north; outside India he is known in Hindu-influenced countries such as Indonesia, Thailand and Malaysia.
claims.statement_id: Kuil kecil Hanuman hampir selalu ada di kantor polisi dan klub gulat di India, terutama di utara; di luar India ia dikenal di negara yang dipengaruhi budaya Hindu seperti Indonesia, Thailand, dan Malaysia.
claims.quote: It is almost de rigueur to find a small shrine to him in police stations and wrestling clubs across the country, especially in the north. Outside of India, Hanuman is known in countries which were influenced by the Hindu culture such as Indonesia, Thailand, and Malaysia.

claims.statement: Hanuman is most often depicted with his favourite weapon, the mace, and often flying across the sky with one hand holding up the mountain of herbs and the other a mace.
claims.statement_id: Hanuman paling sering digambarkan dengan senjata kesayangannya, gada, dan juga sering digambarkan terbang di langit dengan satu tangan mengangkat gunung ramuan dan tangan lain memegang gada.
claims.quote: He is most often depicted with his favourite weapon, the mace. He is also often depicted as flying across the skies, one hand holding aloft the mountain of herbs and the other a mace.

claims.statement: Hanuman is a recurring figure in the Ramayana panels and motifs that adorn temples built over the centuries in India.
claims.statement_id: Hanuman adalah tokoh yang berulang pada panel dan motif Ramayana yang menghiasi candi-candi di India.
claims.quote: Hanuman is a recurring figure in the panels and motifs of the Ramayana that adorn the temples that were built over the centuries in India.

claims.statement: In Griffith's translation the Wind God promises that the child he gives will be strong, brave and wise, with untiring might and limbs that spring as his sire's do.
claims.statement_id: Dalam terjemahan Griffith, Dewa Angin berjanji bahwa anak yang diberikannya akan kuat, berani, dan bijak, bertenaga tak kenal lelah, dengan anggota tubuh yang melompat seperti ayahnya.
claims.quote: So strong and brave and wise shall be The glorious child I give to thee. Might shall be his that naught can tire, And limbs to spring as springs his sire.

claims.statement: In Griffith's Ramayana the child leapt three hundred leagues above the ground after what seemed fruit.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ramayana versi Griffith, si anak melompat tiga ratus league di atas tanah untuk meraih apa yang disangkanya buah.
claims.quote: Up leapt the child, a wondrous bound, Three hundred leagues above the ground

claims.statement: Brahmá bestowed the boon that in the brunt of battle none should slay the Wind-God's son with steel.
claims.statement_id: Brahmá menganugerahkan anugerah bahwa dalam pertempuran tak seorang pun boleh membunuh putra Dewa Angin dengan baja.
claims.quote: And Brahmá's self the boon bestowed That in the brunt of battle none Should slay with steel the Wind-God's son.

claims.statement: Indra swore that the bolt he hurls from heaven should never injure him.
claims.statement_id: Indra bersumpah bahwa petir yang dilemparkannya dari langit tak akan pernah melukai Hanuman.
claims.quote: Lord Indra, sovereign of the skies, Bent on thee all his thousand eyes, And swore that ne'er the bolt which he Hurls from the heaven should injure thee.

claims.statement: In Griffith's Ramayana Indra's bolt struck the child, who fell on a rock and had his cheek shattered.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ramayana versi Griffith, petir Indra menghantam si anak sehingga ia jatuh ke batu dan pipinya remuk.
claims.quote: Then from the hand of Indra came A red bolt winged with wrath and flame. The child fell smitten on a rock, His cheek was shattered by the shock

claims.statement: In his speech Hanumán claims he can circle Meru a thousand times with airy leaps and stir the sea with his arms until its waters flee their bed.
claims.statement_id: Dalam pidatonya, Hanumán mengaku dapat mengelilingi puncak Meru seribu kali dengan lompatan di udara dan mengaduk laut dengan lengannya hingga airnya meninggalkan dasarnya.
claims.quote: A thousand times with airy leap Can circle loftiest Meru's steep: With my fierce arms can stir the sea Till from their bed the waters flee

claims.statement: Hanumán declares he can spring through the air far swifter than the feathered King.
claims.statement_id: Hanumán menyatakan dapat melesat di udara jauh lebih cepat daripada Raja Burung.
claims.quote: I through the fields of air can spring Far swifter than the feathered King

claims.statement: In Griffith's Ramayana Hanumán musters his might and springs from the mountain height, uprooted trees following him.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Ramayana versi Griffith, Hanumán mengerahkan tenaganya dan melompat dari puncak gunung, pepohonan tercabut mengikutinya.
claims.quote: He ceased; and mustering his might Sprang downward from the mountain height, While, shattered by each mighty limb, The trees unrooted followed him.

claims.statement: The shadow of Hanumán's vast form on the ocean flew like a ship before the gale, and the sea beneath his course raged and swelled.
claims.statement_id: Bayangan tubuh raksasa Hanumán di atas samudra meluncur seperti kapal diterpa angin, dan laut di bawah jalurnya bergolak serta menggelembung.
claims.quote: The shadow on the ocean cast By his vast form, as on he passed, Flew like a ship before the gale When the strong breeze has filled the sail, And where his course the Vánar held The sea beneath him raged and swelled.

claims.statement: Hanumán, his soul stirred to vigorous effort, stood before their joyous eyes dilated in gigantic size.
claims.statement_id: Hanumán, jiwanya terdorong untuk berupaya keras, berdiri di depan mata mereka yang bersukacita dengan tubuh membesar hingga ukuran raksasa.
claims.quote: and stood before their joyous eyes Dilated in gigantic size.
