claims.statement: Mars is the Roman war god, second only to Jupiter in the Roman pantheon.
claims.statement_id: Mars adalah dewa perang Romawi yang kedudukannya hanya di bawah Jupiter.
claims.quote: Mars was the Roman god of war and second only to Jupiter in the Roman pantheon.

claims.statement: Mars myths drew on Greek Ares but retained distinct Roman features.
claims.statement_id: Kisah Mars banyak meminjam mitos Ares, tetapi memiliki ciri khas Romawi.
claims.quote: Although most of the myths involving Mars were borrowed from the Greek god of war Ares, Mars did have some uniquely Roman features.

claims.statement: Mars was seen as protector of Rome and its borders.
claims.statement_id: Mars dipandang sebagai pelindung Roma dan perbatasannya.
claims.quote: Mar was a protector of Rome and the Roman way of life. He defended city borders and frontiers.

claims.statement: Mars was said to father Romulus and Remus, Rome's mythical founders.
claims.statement_id: Mars disebut ayah Romulus dan Remus, pendiri mitis Roma.
claims.quote: Mars was considered the father of Romulus and Remus, the mythical twin founders of Rome.

claims.statement: The month Martius was named after Mars.
claims.statement_id: Bulan Martius dinamai dari Mars.
claims.quote: The month of Martius (March) was named after the god.

claims.statement: Some Mars rites may have agricultural links, but his agricultural role is debated.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian ritus Mars mungkin berkaitan dengan pertanian, tetapi perannya dalam bidang itu masih diperdebatkan.
claims.quote: These rites may also have been connected to agriculture but the nature of Mars' role in this area of Roman life is disputed by scholars.

claims.statement: The wolf and woodpecker were associated with Mars.
claims.statement_id: Serigala dan burung pelatuk berkaitan erat dengan Mars.
claims.quote: the god was also closely associated with the wolf and woodpecker.

claims.statement: Temples and altars to Mars stood in Rome and across the empire.
claims.statement_id: Kuil dan altar Mars didirikan di Roma dan seluruh kekaisaran.
claims.quote: Numerous temples, shrines, and altars were dedicated to him in Rome and throughout the Empire.

claims.statement: A Roman relief at The Met portrays Mars as an older bearded man wearing a Corinthian helmet.
claims.statement_id: Relief Romawi di The Met menggambarkan Mars sebagai pria tua berjanggut dengan helm Korintus.
claims.quote: Mars is represented in the canonical guise of an older, bearded man wearing a Corinthian helmet tipped back on his head.

claims.statement: Mars festivals in March and October marked military campaign preparations and closure.
claims.statement_id: Festival Mars berlangsung pada Maret dan Oktober, terkait awal dan akhir musim kampanye militer.
claims.quote: Important festivals and ceremonies, usually connected to the preparation and closure of military campaigns, were held in honour of the god in March and October

claims.statement: Mars is the god of war and also an agricultural guardian, a combination characteristic of early Rome; he is the son of Jupiter and Juno and was pre-eminent among the Roman army's military gods.
claims.statement_id: Mars adalah dewa perang sekaligus pelindung pertanian, perpaduan yang khas Roma awal; ia putra Jupiter dan Juno dan terkemuka di antara dewa-dewa militer tentara Romawi.
claims.quote: is the god of war and also an agricultural guardian, a combination characteristic of early Rome. He is the son of Jupiter and Juno, and was pre-eminent among the Roman army's military gods.

claims.statement: Unlike Ares, who was seen mainly as a destructive and destabilizing force, Mars represented military power as a way to secure peace and was a father (pater) of the Roman people.
claims.statement_id: Berbeda dengan Ares yang dipandang terutama sebagai kekuatan perusak dan pengacau, Mars melambangkan kekuatan militer sebagai cara mengamankan perdamaian dan menjadi bapak (pater) bangsa Romawi.
claims.quote: Unlike Ares, who was viewed primarily as a destructive and destabilizing force, Mars represented military power as a way to secure peace, and was a father (pater) of the Roman people.

claims.statement: Mars's altar in the Campus Martius, the area of Rome named after him, was supposed to have been dedicated by Numa, the peace-loving semi-legendary second king of Rome.
claims.statement_id: Altar Mars di Campus Martius, kawasan Roma yang dinamai menurut namanya, konon didedikasikan oleh Numa, raja kedua Roma yang cinta damai dan setengah legendaris.
claims.quote: Mars's altar in the Campus Martius, the area of Rome that took its name from him, was supposed to have been dedicated by Numa, the peace-loving semi-legendary second king of Rome

claims.statement: Augustus shifted the focus of Mars's cult inside the pomerium (Rome's ritual boundary) and built a temple to Mars Ultor as a key religious feature of his new forum.
claims.statement_id: Augustus memindahkan pusat kultus Mars ke dalam pomerium (batas ritual Roma) dan membangun kuil bagi Mars Ultor sebagai ciri keagamaan utama forum barunya.
claims.quote: Augustus shifted the focus of Mars's cult to within the pomerium (Rome's ritual boundary), and built a temple to Mars Ultor as a key religious feature of his new forum.

claims.statement: Mars's association with the wolf is familiar from what may be the most famous Roman myth: a she-wolf (lupa) suckled his infant sons when they were exposed on the order of King Amulius.
claims.statement_id: Kaitan Mars dengan serigala dikenal dari kisah paling terkenal mitos Romawi: seekor serigala betina (lupa) menyusui putra-putranya yang masih bayi ketika mereka dibuang atas perintah Raja Amulius.
claims.quote: Mars's association with the wolf is familiar from what may be the most famous of Roman myths, the story of how a she-wolf (lupa) suckled his infant sons when they were exposed by order of King Amulius

claims.statement: The wild animals most sacred to Mars were the woodpecker and the wolf, said in Roman natural lore always to inhabit the same foothills and woodlands.
claims.statement_id: Hewan liar yang paling suci bagi Mars adalah burung pelatuk dan serigala, yang menurut pengetahuan alam Romawi selalu menghuni kaki bukit dan hutan yang sama.
claims.quote: The wild animals most sacred to Mars were the woodpecker and the wolf, which in the natural lore of the Romans were said always to inhabit the same foothills and woodlands.

claims.statement: Because the beak of the picus Martius held the god's power to ward off harm, it was carried as a magic charm to prevent bee stings and leech bites.
claims.statement_id: Karena paruh picus Martius mengandung kekuatan sang dewa untuk menangkal bahaya, paruh itu dibawa sebagai jimat untuk mencegah sengatan lebah dan gigitan lintah.
claims.quote: As the beak of the picus Martius contained the god's power to ward off harm, it was carried as a magic charm to prevent bee stings and leech bites.

claims.statement: In the territory of the Aequi, Mars had an oracle of great antiquity where prophecies were supposed to be spoken by a woodpecker perched on a wooden column.
claims.statement_id: Di wilayah bangsa Aequi, Mars memiliki orakel yang sangat kuno, tempat ramalan konon diucapkan oleh burung pelatuk yang bertengger di tiang kayu.
claims.quote: In the territory of the Aequi, another Italic people, Mars had an oracle of great antiquity where the prophecies were supposed to be spoken by a woodpecker perched on a wooden column.

claims.statement: At the Battle of Sentinum in 295 BCE, the appearance of the wolf of Mars (Martius lupus) was a sign that Roman victory was to come.
claims.statement_id: Pada Pertempuran Sentinum tahun 295 SM, munculnya serigala Mars (Martius lupus) menjadi tanda bahwa kemenangan Romawi akan datang.
claims.quote: At the Battle of Sentinum in 295 BCE, the appearance of the wolf of Mars (Martius lupus) was a sign that Roman victory was to come.

claims.statement: In Roman Gaul the goose was associated with the Celtic forms of Mars, and archaeologists have found geese buried alongside warriors in graves.
claims.statement_id: Di Gaul Romawi, angsa dikaitkan dengan bentuk-bentuk Mars versi Kelt, dan arkeolog menemukan angsa dikubur bersama prajurit di makam.
claims.quote: In Roman Gaul, the goose was associated with the Celtic forms of Mars, and archaeologists have found geese buried alongside warriors in graves.

claims.statement: The two most distinctive animal sacrifices to Mars were the suovetaurilia, a triple offering of pig, ram and bull, and the October Horse, the only horse sacrifice known in ancient Rome.
claims.statement_id: Dua kurban hewan yang paling khas bagi Mars adalah suovetaurilia, persembahan tiga hewan (babi, domba jantan, banteng), dan Kuda Oktober, satu-satunya kurban kuda yang diketahui di Roma kuno.
claims.quote: The two most distinctive animal sacrifices made to Mars were the suovetaurilia, a triple offering of a pig (sus), ram (ovis) and bull (taurus), and the October Horse, the only horse sacrifice known to have been carried out in ancient Rome

claims.statement: Cato the Elder invokes Mars Silvanus for a ritual to be carried out in silva, in the woods.
claims.statement_id: Cato yang Tua memanggil Mars Silvanus untuk sebuah ritual yang dilaksanakan di silva, yaitu di hutan.
claims.quote: Cato the Elder invokes Mars Silvanus for a ritual to be carried out in silva

claims.statement: As an agricultural guardian, Mars directs his energies toward creating conditions for crops to grow, which may include warding off hostile forces of nature.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai pelindung pertanian, Mars mengarahkan tenaganya untuk menciptakan kondisi agar tanaman tumbuh, yang mungkin mencakup menangkal kekuatan alam yang bermusuhan.
claims.quote: As an agricultural guardian, Mars directs his energies toward creating conditions that allow crops to grow, which may include warding off hostile forces of nature.

claims.statement: Mars is invoked by the Arval Brotherhood specifically to protect and defend the suppliants from ill.
claims.statement_id: Mars dipanggil oleh Persaudaraan Arval khusus untuk melindungi dan membela para pemohon dari malapetaka.
claims.quote: the god Mars is invoked by the Arval Brotherhood specifically to protect and defend the suppliants from ill.

claims.statement: Mars may have originated as a god of the wild who dwelt beyond the boundaries set by humans.
claims.statement_id: Mars mungkin berasal sebagai dewa alam liar yang bermukim di luar batas yang dibuat manusia.
claims.quote: Mars may have originated as a god of the wild, who dwelt beyond the boundaries set by humans.

claims.statement: Virility as a kind of life force (vis) or virtue (virtus) is an essential characteristic of Mars.
claims.statement_id: Kejantanan sebagai semacam daya hidup (vis) atau keutamaan (virtus) merupakan ciri hakiki Mars.
claims.quote: Virility as a kind of life force (vis ) or virtue (virtus ) is an essential characteristic of Mars.

claims.statement: By the 3rd century CE, Mars was primarily worshipped by Roman military legions.
claims.statement_id: Pada abad ke-3 M, Mars terutama disembah oleh legiun militer Romawi.
claims.quote: By the 3rd-century CE, Mars was primarily worshipped by Roman military legions.

claims.statement: According to Servius, in wartime a spear was shaken in the Regia and Mars was called upon to watch over the Roman people with a set formula.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Servius, pada masa perang sebuah tombak diguncang di Regia dan Mars dipanggil untuk menjaga rakyat Romawi dengan ucapan tertentu.
claims.quote: According to the 4th-century author Servius the Grammarian, during wartime, a spear was shaken in the Regia and Mars was called upon to watch over the Roman people with the words

claims.statement: Like Ares, son of Zeus and Hera, Mars is usually considered the son of Jupiter and Juno; in Ovid's version he was the son of Juno alone.
claims.statement_id: Seperti Ares yang putra Zeus dan Hera, Mars biasanya dianggap putra Jupiter dan Juno; dalam versi Ovidius, ia putra Juno seorang diri.
claims.quote: Like Ares who was the son of Zeus and Hera, Mars is usually considered to be the son of Jupiter and Juno. In Ovid's version of Mars's origin, he was the son of Juno alone.

claims.statement: In Ovid's version Flora obtained a magic flower, tested it on a heifer that became fecund at once, and touched Juno's belly with it, impregnating her.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi Ovidius, Flora memperoleh bunga ajaib, mengujinya pada anak sapi betina yang langsung subur, lalu menyentuh perut Juno dengan bunga itu dan membuatnya hamil.
claims.quote: Flora obtained a magic flower (Latin flos, plural flores, a masculine word) and tested it on a heifer who became fecund at once. Flora ritually plucked a flower, using her thumb, touched Juno's belly, and impregnated her. ... Ovid tells this story in the Fasti, his long-form poetic work on the Roman calendar.

claims.statement: Ovid is the only source for the story.
claims.statement_id: Ovidius adalah satu-satunya sumber untuk kisah itu.
claims.quote: Ovid is the only source for the story.

claims.statement: The consort of Mars was Nerio or Neriene, meaning "Valor".
claims.statement_id: Pasangan Mars adalah Nerio atau Neriene, yang berarti "Keberanian".
claims.quote: The consort of Mars was Nerio or Neriene, meaning "Valor".

claims.statement: In the early 3rd century BCE, the comic playwright Plautus refers to Mars greeting Nerio, his wife.
claims.statement_id: Pada awal abad ke-3 SM, penulis komedi Plautus menyinggung Mars menyapa Nerio, istrinya.
claims.quote: In the early 3rd century BCE, the comic playwright Plautus has a reference to Mars greeting Nerio, his wife.

claims.statement: Although not originally part of the Roman tradition, in 217 BCE Venus and Mars were presented as a complementary pair in the lectisternium.
claims.statement_id: Meski semula bukan bagian tradisi Romawi, pada 217 SM Venus dan Mars ditampilkan sebagai pasangan yang saling melengkapi dalam lectisternium.
claims.quote: Although not originally part of the Roman tradition, in 217 BCE Venus and Mars were presented as a complementary pair in the lectisternium

claims.statement: The oldest recorded Latin form, Mamart-, is likely of foreign origin; it has been explained as deriving from Maris, an Etruscan child-god, though this is not universally agreed.
claims.statement_id: Bentuk Latin tertua yang tercatat, Mamart-, mungkin berasal dari luar; ada penjelasan yang menurunkannya dari Maris, nama dewa anak Etruria, meski tidak disepakati semua orang.
claims.quote: The oldest recorded Latin form, Mamart-, is likely of foreign origin. It has been explained as deriving from Maris, the name of an Etruscan child-god, though this is not universally agreed upon.

claims.statement: The older etymology equating Mars with the Vedic Maruts is now rejected in more modern Indo-Europeanist scholarship.
claims.statement_id: Etimologi yang menyamakan Mars dengan Marut Weda kini ditolak dalam kajian Indo-Eropa yang lebih modern.
claims.quote: In older literature, the god Mars was equated with the Vedic storm deities known as the Maruts ... However, this etymology is now rejected in more modern Indo-Europeanist scholarship.

claims.statement: In older literature, Mars was equated with the Vedic storm deities known as the Maruts.
claims.statement_id: Dalam literatur lama, Mars disamakan dengan dewa-dewa badai Weda yang disebut Marut.
claims.quote: In older literature, the god Mars was equated with the Vedic storm deities known as the Maruts

claims.statement: Latin adjectives from the name of Mars mean "of Mars" or "warlike", from which the English term "martial" derives.
claims.statement_id: Kata sifat Latin turunan nama Mars berarti "milik Mars" atau "suka perang", yang melahirkan kata Inggris "martial".
claims.quote: Latin adjectives from the name of Mars are ... meaning "of Mars" or "warlike" from which derive the English term "martial"

claims.statement: In the mythological origin of Rome outlined by the 1st-century BCE poet Virgil, Mars was cast as the ancestor of Romulus and Venus as the ancestor of Aeneas.
claims.statement_id: Dalam asal-usul mitologis Roma yang diuraikan penyair Virgil abad ke-1 SM, Mars adalah leluhur Romulus dan Venus leluhur Aeneas.
claims.quote: Within the mythological origin of Rome outlined by the 1st-century BCE poet Virgil, Mars was cast as the ancestor of Romulus and Venus as the ancestor of Aeneas

claims.statement: Mars is considered more level-headed than the impulsive and disruptive Ares, and more virtuous to the martially minded Romans.
claims.statement_id: Mars dianggap lebih tenang daripada Ares Yunani yang impulsif dan pengacau, dan lebih berbudi luhur bagi orang Romawi yang berorientasi militer.
claims.quote: Mars is considered more level-headed than the impulsive and disruptive Ares. Mars is also a more virtuous figure to the more martial-oriented Romans.

claims.statement: In the story their mother, the Vestal Virgin Rhea Silvia, was raped by Mars while she slept, and in a dream she dropped a hairpin that sprang up as two twin trees.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kisahnya, ibu mereka, Perawan Vesta Rhea Silvia, diperkosa Mars saat tidur, dan dalam mimpinya ia melihat jepit rambut yang dijatuhkannya menumbuhkan dua pohon kembar.
claims.quote: According to the story, their mother, the Vestal Virgin Rhea Silvia, was raped by Mars while she slept, and in her dreams she had a vision where she dropped a hairpin to the ground, and from which there sprang two twin trees.

claims.statement: Anna Perenna fancied the war god for herself and double-crossed Mars by disguising herself as Minerva, veiled, tricking him into marrying her.
claims.statement_id: Anna Perenna menyukai sang dewa perang untuk dirinya sendiri, lalu menipu Mars dengan menyamar sebagai Minerva dan berkerudung sehingga Mars menikahinya.
claims.quote: However, Anna Perenna quite fancied the handsome war god for herself, and so she double-crossed Mars by disguising herself as Minerva and, wearing a veil, she tricked the god into marrying her.

claims.statement: Another uniquely Roman myth is Mars's marriage to Anna Perenna; the story, retold in Ovid's Fasti, begins with Mars falling in love with Minerva.
claims.statement_id: Mitos khas Romawi lainnya adalah pernikahan Mars dengan Anna Perenna; kisah yang diceritakan ulang dalam Fasti karya Ovidius ini bermula ketika Mars jatuh cinta kepada Minerva.
claims.quote: Another myth concerning the god of war, this one uniquely Roman, was his marriage to Anna Perenna. The story is re-told in Ovid's Fasti and begins with Mars falling in love with no less a figure than Minerva

claims.statement: Mars again took centre stage at the Equus October on 15 October, when a great horse race was held in the Campus Martius of Rome.
claims.statement_id: Mars kembali menjadi pusat perhatian pada Equus October, 15 Oktober, ketika perlombaan kuda besar diadakan di Campus Martius, Roma.
claims.quote: Mars again took centre stage during the Equus October, held on the 15th of that month. This was when a great horse race was held in the Campus Martius of Rome.

claims.statement: Finally the Armilustrium festival on 19 October, held on the Aventine, involved the purification of weapons before they were stored away for the winter.
claims.statement_id: Terakhir ada festival Armilustrium pada 19 Oktober di Aventine, berupa penyucian senjata sebelum disimpan selama musim dingin.
claims.quote: Finally, there was the Armilustrium festival on the 19th of October, held on the Aventine and which involved the purification of weapons before they were stored away for the winter.

claims.statement: The Tubilustrium involved rites to cleanse and favour trumpets, while the Equirria ensured all would be well with the horses on campaign.
claims.statement_id: Tubilustrium berupa rangkaian ritus membersihkan dan memberkati terompet, sedangkan Equirria memastikan kuda-kuda baik-baik saja saat berkampanye.
claims.quote: The Tubilustrium involved a series of rites to cleanse and favour trumpets, whilst the Equirria was to ensure all would be well with the horses when on campaign.

claims.statement: Another important ritual was performed by the commander of the departing army, who shook the god's sacred spears kept in the Regia.
claims.statement_id: Ritus penting lain dilakukan panglima pasukan yang hendak berangkat dengan mengguncang tombak suci sang dewa yang disimpan di Regia.
claims.quote: Another important ritual was performed by the commander of the army about to depart who shook the sacred spears of the god which were kept in the Regia.

claims.statement: On 1, 9 and 23 March the priests called the Salii sang hymns and dressed in bronze-age armour including the ancient figure-of-eight ancilia shields.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1, 9, dan 23 Maret, para imam Salii menyanyikan himne dan mengenakan baju zirah zaman perunggu termasuk perisai ancilia berbentuk angka delapan.
claims.quote: On the 1st, 9th and 23rd of March, the priests of this sacred trio, the Salii, sang hymns and dressed themselves in bronze-age armour which included the ancient ancilia figure-of-eight shields.

claims.statement: Mars was also involved in ceremonies for the ancient triad of gods that included himself, Jupiter and Quirinus.
claims.statement_id: Mars juga terlibat dalam upacara untuk triad dewa kuno yang terdiri dari dirinya, Jupiter, dan Quirinus.
claims.quote: he was also involved with ceremonies relating to the ancient triad of gods which included himself, Jupiter, and Quirinus.

claims.statement: The ceremonies were carried out by Mars' specially dedicated priests, the flamen Martialis.
claims.statement_id: Upacara itu dilaksanakan oleh imam khusus Mars, flamen Martialis.
claims.quote: were held in honour of the god in March and October and carried out by Mars' specially dedicated priests, the flamen Martialis.

claims.statement: In Livy the Vestal was forcibly violated and gave birth to twins; she named Mars as their father, either because she believed it or because the fault might seem less heinous if a deity were the cause.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Livy, Perawan Vesta itu dinodai dengan paksa dan melahirkan anak kembar; ia menyebut Mars sebagai ayah mereka, entah karena sungguh percaya atau agar kesalahannya tampak lebih ringan jika seorang dewa penyebabnya.
claims.quote: The Vestal was forcibly violated and gave birth to twins. She named Mars as their father, either because she really believed it, or because the fault might appear less heinous if a deity were the cause of it.

claims.statement: In Livy a thirsty she-wolf from the surrounding hills, drawn by the children's crying, came and suckled them and was so gentle that the king's flock-master found her licking the boys.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Livy, seekor serigala betina yang haus dari bukit sekitar datang karena tangisan anak-anak itu, menyusui mereka, dan begitu lembut hingga gembala raja mendapatinya menjilati anak-anak itu.
claims.quote: a thirsty she-wolf from the surrounding hills, attracted by the crying of the children, came to them, gave them her teats to suck and was so gentle towards them that the king's flock-master found her licking the boys with her tongue.
